limitations: This verdict covers the local working copy and the illustrations-v1 full synthetic catalog. Git publication and external course submission are separate.
The frozen single-stack 10-warmup, 100-serial-call latency benchmark was rechecked from raw samples. Cold reproduction was independently executed; no concurrent multi-stack latency claim.

The observed deployment CT candidate v1.1 was RETAINED and the serving model remained v1.0. A separate full-size constant-initial fixture demonstrated promotion/reload/rollback using the exact candidate. All 10,054 newly observed events were in the held-out chronological test interval.

Independent default 4-thread FAISS HNSW build: text/image/hybrid neighbor graphs differed. Identical vectors and query identities verified. The independently frozen 600-query test passed both search quality targets; see cold_search_quality.json.

Cold build used an independent local clone with the unpublished source overlay, empty data/models/results, the pinned pretrained CLIP cache and existing dependency layers. External real-dataset evaluation is outside this required acceptance scope.
